title: Ethiopian Fish Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Ethiopia, made with fish and a blend of spices.

ingredients.name: Unique Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: A mix of turmeric, coriander, cinnamon, and cumin

ingredients.name: Umami Broth
ingredients.notes: You can use store-bought or homemade broth

ingredients.name: Stew Seasoning
ingredients.notes: A mix of paprika, salt, and black pepper

instructions: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes and cook for another 5 minutes.
Add the fish and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the broth, spice blend, and stew seasoning. Bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10-12 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Stir in the lime juice and cook for an additional minute.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro if desired.
